name: Efficient Voxel Marking for Hierarchical Volumetric Fusion
aliases: Multi-level DDA ray-casting for macro-voxel marking
definition: A GPU-based algorithm to mark hierarchical macro-cells as empty or intersected by a noisy depth surface, using multi-level DDA ray-casting driven by depth image pixels to avoid atomic writes and high thread divergence.
summary: Efficient Voxel Marking for Hierarchical Volumetric Fusion is a scattering-type method that marks macro-voxels as empty or intersected using atomic-free byte-separated flags, minimizing thread divergence compared to gathering approaches.
